name: elizaos-plugin-foliant
description: ElizaOS plugin: pay x402 endpoints from a Foliant account with a budget the agent cannot bypass; one on-chain settlement per session

FOLIANT_NODE_URL.description: URL of the Foliant ledger node (devnet: http://127.0.0.1:8402)

FOLIANT_SIGNER_KEY.description: Hex Ed25519 private key that operates the agent's Foliant account

FOLIANT_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Existing account id operated by FOLIANT_SIGNER_KEY (for example one delegated by an orchestrator); omit to register a new devnet account with FOLIANT_OWNER_KEY

FOLIANT_OWNER_KEY.description: Hex Ed25519 private key of the account owner; used only to register a new account when FOLIANT_ACCOUNT_ID is not set

FOLIANT_DEFAULT_DEPOSIT.description: Deposit per channel open or pool join, in smallest units (default 100)

FOLIANT_WINDOW_SECS.description: New-account policy: window length in seconds (default 3600)

FOLIANT_AUTOPAY.description: 'true' to pay 402s without asking (default true on devnet)
